title: API response assurance: primary and transfer protocol
selection: Fixed historical release sequence chosen by version identifiers before download; discovery v25->v26 excluded. Six complete primary questions, two separate minor-release transfer questions; correlated source lineage, not customer trials.

arms.A: Strong independently authored retained conventional Python workflow
arms.B: Same installed Workbench with full response index and fixture admission
arms.C: Workbench plus retained incremental index through equal-information registry
arms.D: Identical skills and evidence through graph selection

additional_alternative: oasdiff v1.34.1 on swagger2openapi7.0.8 converted inputs; broader semantics differ, findings not equated to structural-dossier acceptance
order: Rotate A/B/C/D by job index mod4; once per arm per job, no efficacy reruns
acceptance: Independent exhaustive schema traversal verifies every changed tuple, old/new node counts, input/source digests and changed-node reference provenance. Every missing, extra or duplicate delta fails. Declared unassessed scopes remain visible. No live-client or whole-API compatibility claim.
reporting: Every acquired exact source and its license
Every command stdout/stderr/exit/wall/CPU/maxRSS and acceptance result
Rejected outputs and tool/format/source failures remain costs
Include verification and packaging in complete-service resource totals
Shared retrieval and construction charged once with allocation visible
No human-duration or actual bill inferred from agent wall clock
transfer: Two independently reconstructed capable agents keep their own programs. Received module tested on two unseen minor-release pairs; compare actual outputs and total resource burden; no repeated reconstruction per job. Both public tool search and20min reconstruction allowances preceded donor access.
stopping: Missing source, runtime limit or acceptance failure remains an explicit failed case. No case replacement, source repair or favorable subset in primary. Any later repair is a separately named successor with original preserved.
economics: Freeze calibrated market inputs and source after all production results, before market outcomes. Actual collections0; actual complete authoring/inference/human cost null; priced sensitivity conditions explicit assumptions. No market launch or live ENS validation.
